label: TP
reason: User input flows through Base64 encode/decode cycle then directly constructs file path via string concatenation without validation. While ESAPI encoder protects against XSS, the path traversal vulnerability remains active since '..' characters survive the transform and enable directory traversal.

evidence.note: Input param flows through Base64 decode/encode (lines 50-52) then directly concatenated to construct fileName (line 60) which opens FileInputStream (line 66)
